_note: Paths config for the synthetic smoke test only (scripts/smoke_test.py sets QAV2_PATHS_CONFIG to this file). data_root points at the hand-written fixtures under tests/fixtures/, which are fabricated - no MuSiQue or MetaQA rows. Real runs use configs/paths.json. Keys mirror paths.json exactly; only the roots differ. The fixture files behind musique_eval_questions_template keep the real file names (which end in _200) but hold 3 fabricated rows each, not 200 - they exist so the MuSiQue decomposer path and the train/eval overlap assertion can be exercised, not to stand in for the evaluation set.

eval_set_expected._note: Overrides eval_set.expected in configs/finetune_decomposer.json for the fixture tree. The fabricated per-hop files carry 3 rows each, not the 200 of ADR 0007, so the counts src/finetune_data.py asserts have to be declared here rather than relaxed in code: the assertion is what stops a mis-resolved id field from leaving the train/eval overlap check with nothing to check. configs/paths.json carries no such block, so real runs assert 200 per hop / 600 total. (Was 1 per hop until issue #12 needed more than one row per hop depth in the same files; the ids of the 1-per-hop set are still present.)
